critical_code_review_comments: ListenToArticle briefly renders before unmounting on media error; harmless but could cause a tiny CLS flash on slow networks. Consider rendering audio with preload='metadata' and gating UI on 'canplay' rather than mounting-then-removing. Low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vocolens is a static TanStack Start + React 19 site served by Vite on :3000 (no backend). Use curl for SSR'd head/JSON-LD checks and Playwright for interactive. There are no data-testid attributes on blog pages — use semantic selectors. Expected console error: 404 for /audio/mixed-emotions.mp3 (ListenToArticle hides itself on media error). All features and regressions verified in iteration_2.
